name: Admin List Filter
description: Adds a client-side 'filter by name' search box (the same one Drupal core ships on /admin/modules) to many admin config-entity listing pages, by swapping in filterable list-builder classes.
project_description:
Drupal core provides a helpful filter input on the Extend page (/admin/modules) that lets administrators quickly find modules by typing part of the name. Admin List Filter brings that same filtering capability to other admin listing pages like Content types, Vocabularies, Menus, and more. Zero configuration is required: install and the filter is automatically available on supported admin pages.

The module implements hook_entity_type_alter() to replace the default list-builder handler class of each supported entity type with a subclass that mixes in one of two traits. FilterableListBuilderTrait targets standard (EntityListBuilder-style) lists and adds a #type=search input plus the table-filter-text / table-filter-text-source CSS classes in render()/buildRow(); FilterableDraggableListBuilderTrait does the same for draggable (weighted, form-based) lists in buildForm(). Both attach core's system/drupal.system.modules library, so filtering happens entirely client-side in the browser with no AJAX and no server load. Supported core entity types include content types, comment types, block types, contact forms, date formats, field storage, text formats, image styles, responsive image styles, media types, menus, search pages, shortcut sets, taxonomy vocabularies, user roles, languages, and workflows; pathauto_pattern and metatag_defaults are also handled when those contrib modules are installed.
